doc.name: catchlog
doc.description: catchlog is a public web service from rowb.app. It is a fishing catch logbook: write an entry, read entries back, and get a tally. This service is a plain web service - it is NOT an A2A JSON-RPC agent. Docs at the documentationUrl.

skills.name: record_catch
skills.description: Store one catch in the logbook (date, species, place, and optional length/weight/method/weather/water temperature).

skills.name: list_entries
skills.description: List the entries stored in your own logbook, newest first.

skills.name: catch_summary
skills.description: Count totals, longest, heaviest, per species, per place and per month from your own entries.
